chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, from Hisham bin Abdul-Malik, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the meaning of «Glorified be Allah», to which he said: An honoring of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Subhan Allah' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines 'Subhan Allah' as 'Anfat Allah', a term denoting Allah’s self-sufficiency and majesty that inspires awe and reverence in the believer. This interpretation highlights the attribute of *Al-Aziz* (The Mighty) and underscores the psychological and spiritual impact of glorification, distinguishing it from mere verbal recitation by emphasizing the internal sense of honor and exaltation.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Muhammed bin ‘Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, from Hisham bin Abdul-Malik, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the meaning of «Glorified be Allah» [1], to which he said: An honoring of Allah.
